thesis: The episode introduces Shundrawn Thomas, president of Northern Trust Asset Management, who oversees a $900 billion organization and has led diversity efforts since joining the firm in 2004. Thomas describes his career progression from an accounting interest to capital markets investing, noting his early transition to management at Goldman Sachs where he served as a 'player coach' and benefited from mentorship starting with his parents.
